description: What depends on this node — what breaks if I change it? Before changing or redeploying a node, see its downstream dependents and evidence-bearing paths. Returns the bounded blast radius so an edit plan includes the affected services, routes, data, and callers.

nodeId.description: Graph node id to compute blast radius from

project.description: Project name when the core hosts more than one (set NEAT_PROJECTS=...). Omit to use the default project.

name: get_blast_radius
